title: File:Bewicks-newfoundland.jpg
author: Thomas Bewick (1753-1828), wood engraving "The Newfoundland Dog" from A General History of Quadrupeds (Newcastle, first published 1790); Commons dates this copy 1834
used_as: the old dog (the critic): the engraved dog cut out of its landscape into head, body, tail and four legs and hinged with pins (films/swarm/dogs/kennel_a.py). The cutting, the poses, the motion and a strip of neck fur borrowed from the mane are invented; the print itself is unaltered and reassembles at rest.
